meta.title: Radiation Dose Equivalent Converter — Convert Sievert and More
meta.description: Free radiation dose equivalent converter for 5+ units including Sievert, Millisievert, Microsievert. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Sievert, rem. Convert between 5 radiation dose equivalent units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for radiation dose equivalent in this tool is **Sv**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most radiation dose equivalent conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |

content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this radiation dose equivalent converter?
**A:** It uses 5 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Sievert (Sv), Millisievert (mSv), Microsievert (µSv), Rem (rem), Millirem (mrem).
